column3: This week, we moved into a new house with my family.
Everyone has been so busy unpacking...
I get a nice view from my new spot, at least...
And this is Shay! My human and my best friend!
She seems to be nervous about the new school and everything.
But I am here to make her feel better!
Me and my human don't have many other friends- and, well, we don't need 'em!
More importantly, [wave]Halloween[/wave] is around the corner!
I can't wait to spend a calm afternoon watching horror movies with Shay!
You wake up to the sound of arguing...
You should go out more often!
There are so many kids your age in this neighborhood!
Mrs. Dudley said her daughter would love to go trick-or-treating with you!
Well, her older brother is going to be there.
You two go to the same school.
It could be an opportunity to get to know one another.
But mom- Spook and I already have plans!
We're going to see [b]"Zombie Rats Take Over the World Again"[/b]!
Well, I'm sure you can watch your movie after you go trick-or-treating!
Come on, Shay. It's going to be fun!
...And can I stay up late to watch the movie...?
How am I gonna spend an entire night with people I don't even know?!
This is gonna be a disaster!
A bigger disaster than third grade picture day!
It's Halloween! It's going to be awesome whether they like me or not!
And we'll have some candy for our movie too! Isn't that awesome?!
What are you doing in my house?!
I thought you only owned that little box you're in, hehe.
No! The whole house! It's my human's house and mine!
You see, this whole street is mine.
I watched 'em build your little house from dirt and concrete.
And when you lot pack up and move on?
I am not going to leave!
And I'm not a kid! I'm one and a half years old!
[wave]Ooooo![/wave] The little guy is actually so big!
But you are a kid. You know so little of the world.
And you rely on another to take care of you, no?
Adults have their own lives. Adults feed themselves. Adults-
I get it, I get it!
Why don't I open that metallic little box for you and show you how a pest lives?
No! Shay would be worried sick!
Heh heh, worry not, friend. Some of us have humans, too.
We party all night, then crawl back into the cages.
Not me, of course! I'm a free spirit.
The veil [wave]thins,[/wave] the night is [wave]alive,[/wave] and the critters [wave]celebrate![/wave] Heh heh heh.
Indeed we do, friend. Indeed we do.
Then she will find you in the morning!
Ugh... dunno. Are you a screwdriver?
...Let's just go before we wake up Shay!
He-he, fear not little one! I don't bite!
Don't mess with the kid, Pogo!
Don't worry, she's harmless as a fly!
I am Barry, the bartender. Pleasure.
My sweet... My sweet... How I miss my sweet...
Finish your drink, man... Your "sweet" is not going anywhere. Literally.
You're the one who hasn't gone on a single date!
Love is a trap, and attachment is a fancy word for a leash!
My sweet is not a leash... My sweet is so bright...
Hey Spook, before I forget, take this.
It's a map. Use it if you ever get lost around here!
Well, that's it from me guys. The night is young!
Yup. Gonna go stretch my wings tonight. [wave]Byeee~[/wave]
Go on, friend. I'll be here if you need anything.
Alright... Let's see where this goes.
Shay is sound asleep. Your cage is warm and inviting.
Wow! You still react the same!
Night is young! Go explore! Go!
[wave]My father... took me into the city...[/wave]
Hey! What are you looking at?!
Not your bedtime yet, is it?
Hey! Why do you keep coming back here?
For the last time, I'm not giving his heart undies back!
He asked me to get some candy in exchange for a drink.
He's putting a newbie to work?
My, raccoons are indeed greedy, aren't they?
Let's break into that big fancy house across the street!
Heh, they got a bodyguard? Idiots!
Screwdriver leads you through an underground gateway...
Should we really be doing this?
Yes, warn me if she wakes up. The code word is "Squeak!" nyeh heh!
It's a well groomed, fluffy dog. Her perfume smells like cinnamon and she is wearing a single pink hair pin.
[shake]Oh my god. Oh my god. Oh my god.[/shake]
Whoa, calm down kid! Wasn't that a [shake]RUSH???[/shake]
[shake]I'M A THIEF!!! WHAT IS SHAY GOING TO SAY!??[/shake]
If anything, [shake]I'm[/shake] the thief, OK? You were just my little helper! Don't give yourself all the credit!
I'm taking this as "we got the candy"?
'course we did! Pour the guy a drink now! He clearly needs to chill out!
We were just back from... Trick or treatin'.
Everyone joins in for Barry's Special Cider With Crushed Candy and Extra Cream: BSCWCCEC!
(No, there is no shorter name for it)
Man... I miss playing together... This bar used to be [wave]waaay[/wave] more lively...
Yeah, too bad we lost our drummer like that...
I guess that is better than dead.
Told ya, kid. The bar used to be way livelier.
Let's not dig up old skeletons...
Why not Barry? It is past midnight. Officially [shake]Hallow's Eve!!!![/shake]
What's a better time to rise from the dead?!
Never! Never is a good time!
Weird, the vibe suddenly got so depressing.
Nope! These days I'm hanging out with my gang, the R.A.C.
You should join in! We have motorcycles and everything!
Are you a mouse against capitalism?
I still sing sometimes, but not on stage or anything.
I don't even know where the old guitar is...
I mean, dunno. I sold a lot of old stuff to the forest folk... And it's definitely not in my lair.
Ahem! I'm calling it a night! Are you going home yet, Spook?
Ahem! I'm calling it a night! Are you going home yet, Spook?
Well, have a good morning's sleep!
Hope you enjoyed your first night out!
Yeah, gonna stay a bit longer. I got some crow customers visiting at dawn...
Wow, someone is becoming a real night owl! Heh.
Nights are a perfect time to wander about. Good choice, little mouse!
Should I go to sleep now?
It's your first night out, hm? Are you excited?
The streets might seem dangerous at night, but for us pests, it's full of danger during the day, too.
That's why we learn to look after one other!
I remember when Drivey and Pogo were just kids...
Now now, don't let me talk your ear off. You want a drink?
We look after each other, but the careless don't live long out in the streets... heh.
So, what can I get you then?
What can you offer in return?
Barry's no charity, buddy. Or else it would be called... Barrity....
Look. How about you help me restock the Halloween candy, and I make you my special drink?
We don't even serve poop, most days!
But no, it may not be for pet standards.
So, you know, feel free to leave.
Well thank you very much. I sure try to keep it that way!
I guess a single drink wouldn't hurt.
In the mood for something specific?
Eager for a night out, are you not?
In this community, we earn what we get!
How about you help me restock some Halloween candy, and then we toast together?
This is a bar, not the grocery store!
Well, cider... cheese, candy, leftover food, oat, rotten fruit....
Tell you what, If you can help me restock the Halloween candy, I can make you my special drink.
Well, you order a drink, you pay, friend!
Do you have something else to pay with?
Screwdriver brings all kinds of things.
But also music, books, small furniture, even human money...
Know what? Try catching up with Screwdriver. He can show you a trick or two!
More for ther rest of us, heh.
But where do I get the candy from?
Your human, another human, the candy shop...
Know what? Go find Screwdriver. He is a professional looter, afterall.
Hey, kid. Didn't you want to go out and explore?
I know. Just wanted to hang out in here a bit more!
Soooo... why do they call it Foggy Hallow?
Well, I better be going then!
No, I just like the place!
Appreciate it. But you shouldn't waste time on an old timer like me.
Go out and make some friends, kid!
I insist. C'mon, go out there!
Big world, is it not? The sky is even bigger!
Don't you wish you could fly, too?
The best things in life often are!
How are you ever going to learn what could it be like, if you never spread your wings?
That doesn't stop humans, does it?
Let me know if you ever want a ride!
He-he! I could take you on a ride, if you wanted to.
The city lights are beautiful from above...
Though we would need to tie you up well! Wouldn't want you to fly off!
Though there is no shame in being lost!
Mmm, yes-yes. A classic truly. Up there with Poe in my favorite book-list!
I guess it's normal- knowing this is your first time going out by yourself....
We used to write lyrics to songs together.
They definitely sounded better once we knew about letters. Heheh!
Now I am just a gal who loves books.
My human reads to me sometimes!
Well. Of course. Who doesn't love a little [shake]mouse juice[/shake] after a good horror book....
Heh. I'll leave you be, little one.
Ah, a fellow little nerd! What a joy!
Which stories are your favorite, then?
Ooh, we will just be besties!!! [wave]How exciting!!![/wave]
Y'know, we could read some books together!
You wouldn't believe how many of them people throw away or just leave behind!
Barry has a whole library at this point!
Well then, don't let me keep you. The night is young.
But definitely do hit me up when you want a new book to read!
Y'know, most fairytales hide darker stories behind them...
Think of the little red! A stranger followed the little girl home.
He found her grandma because of her.
No one thinks about the part where the sick old lady screamed and cried out in terror!
And that wolf? How big that mouth had to open? How many teeth did he have? [shake]That was no wolf.[/shake]
Everyone who lived long enough in a forest knows that shadows lurk out there!
[shake]Way worse[/shake] things than wolves! [shake]Way worse, truly...[/shake]
[shake]BWAHAHAHA![/shake] But this isn't a forest! This is our street!
Me too! From time to time, I suppose.
Me and Drivey sometimes read trashy romance for fun!
But more often than not, I get carried away and end up actually caring about the story...
Doesn't everything feel like a sci-fi novel, when you think about it?
I mean, humans get all excited, because, oh my god- a flying object we can't identify!
What [shake]IF[/shake] we could shoot lasers from guns!?
...Then again, everything they made seems equally impossible.
I just don't get why a car isn't as exciting as a spaceship. Different metal? It can [shake]FLY[/shake]? So what? Heh.
I just don't understand some things about humans, I s'pose...
"The day after tomorrow, we are leaving for sure, Candide!"
Oh my, aren't you too interested in me?
I just wanna hear your story again!
My favorite drink is grape juice...
And my favorite author is Marry Shelley!
And Dracula is my biggest crush, big time. Too bad I was born so late....
Maybe you will meet a vampire during Halloween!
But what if they have a taste for mouses-
Well, I always wanted to be a singer as a little girl!
I used to sing towards the mountains, so my voice would echo. It felt like a whole stage!
Hm... Been a while, no. But I could say I accomplished a dream in a way.
Now I am content with just being a little night dweller, hanging out with my friends!
Oh, you know sweetie... It's just not the same anymore.
...Dunno. Passion and inspiration are rare to find. Back then things were... different.
But "nothing easy is ever amazing" or something, right!?
Am not worried about you at all, kid.
You will do [wave]juuuuust[/wave] fine among us!
Hmm, didn't you get [wave]really[/wave] scared last time you asked this?
I'm just... a little curious again!
You wanna know the tales of the [shake]ancient fog?[/shake]
Um... Yes? Is it [wave]always[/wave] foggy or something?
Some say it's coming from under the dirt, not the sky.
You see, this part of the town is always foggy, more or less, even if it's a clear sky outside!
And if you walk a little away, you can actually see that surrounding areas aren't effected...
The fog travels through streets like branches of veins. They say it follows the roots underground.
Beats me, friend! Maybe there is something lurking right under our feet.
Hehe, your face is so funny when you're afraid, little mouse!
I'm not afraid! Just a little... you know!
You really wanna hear the story of that old place again?
When I was just a pup, I met Barry in the woods! Neither of us had much going on back then.
But, well- Barry and Drivey are old friends.
They taught me how I can loot trash cans, all the good spots in town...
We used to just light fires and make-up stories under that sewer back then!
Soon the other strays joined us- and we carried what we collected over to years under the sewer.
It was a safe haven for every unloved animal!
And well, soon we had drinks, music, new friends...
Now it's pretty much a club for anyone who is willing to contribute to our little community!
Wait, but is it really only for strays?
Screwdriver told me some of you go back to cages in the morning!
Oh, sweetie. We had other pets who joined us at night, and very often.
And it's not for me to tell, either way.
Don't worry, just keep hanging around the bar. You'll find out, eventually.
Oh, you know. Humans are evolved to fear some of us.
Of course, we are evolved to fear each other as well.
But while we were able to put that to the side and build a community...
Humans are most likely always going to be judgemental of creatures like us!
Really? Would she let me into her house?
Yeah! Shay loves bats! She never kills bugs, too!
Oh my. You got a special human, don't you? What a lucky mouse!
The air smells like cinnamon and apple pie. Autumn leaves drift by.
I'm not a hamster, I'm a mouse.
Well, everyone always calls [shake]me[/shake] a mouse!
I guess you are right. I never met a mouse.
Never? But you hang out outside!
I am home where my beloved human is!
...Dude. I don't get it. Aren't you with those sewer punks?
Well, whatever! Still! You are in my home!
Uh... Just so we're clear! You know!
You were here when I walked in!
First of all! Hamsters aren't fit for a cage!
We are burrowers and we require deep bedding that won't spill out and plenty of textures to live comfortable, long lives!
Hamsters aren't fit for a cage!
We are burrowers and we require deep bedding that won't spill out and plenty of textures to live comfortable, long lives!
Then why aren't you- well, in your enclosure?
How [shake]DARE[/shake] you stand on [shake]MY[/shake] land and question [shake]ME[/shake]!
Hamster balls are horrific machines of torture that will disorient and rob sensory of a roaming hamster!
[shake]We roam! We chew! We are free! Opressor![/shake]
And [shake]YOU[/shake] could be in a hamster ball, too! Since when pet mice are such free spirits!
It's called a hamster ball! Not a mouse ball!
Well? And I know of a thing called a "mouse trap." Do you just walk into it because of that?
I was there a while ago.
I am waiting for my human to come back!
So she can find me here!
But hey now! What's with the line of questioning, punk!
This is my yard! You will treat me with respect!
You don't even have cheek pockets!
It's disgusting to carry food like that, okay!?
[shake]CURSES ON YOU!!!! CURSES ON YOUR CHEESE, YOUR BURROWS, THE LAND OF YOUR OWNERS! CURSES!!![shake]
I know the difference between a mouse and a hamster!
Are you gonna join the Halloween party?
Why, of course! Of course I will!
Cool. So I will see you there...?
I blinked and that hamster just took off!
Excuse me, um, Mr. Rabbit? Could you please move aside?
You try to push him, but the rabbit doesn't move an inch!
Hmm, I'll just try another entrance.
You try every window you can climb to, but the house seems heavily guarded!
Maybe try again during the day, when the rabbit is awake.
I wonder if that dog woke up. We shouldn't have caused so much trouble just to get some drinks!
At least, that's what I should've said...
Hey! Mr. rabbit! Are you asleep?
Well... I guess I can come in?
You try to push him, but the rabbit doesn't move an inch!
Huh. That is one way to guard a door.
Maybe I should try the other entrance, just like last time.
You try to enter through the underground gateway again, but it is nowhere to be found.
Wait, is this the right side of the house? I can't remember...
You searched again, to no avail.
This is impossible! I'm clearly not fit to be a burglar!
I should just ask Screwdriver to show me the hidden entrance again later...
Maybe I should try again during the day.
A bright light flickers rapidly. The moth from the bar is glaring into it with loving eyes.
You see my lover? She is excited to see me.
You want to be smart when speaking of the lamp, little mouse.
They know things about you no one else can ever know...
The bright light that mortals are drawn to before death?
The lamp will one day reap your soul.
You are going to wish you respected the lamp some more.
My lamp, my beloved, my source of light.
She whispers sweet nothings to me all night.
She would whisper to you, too.
So she is only mine, my sweet lamp.
I will give you two some privacy...
Maybe it's time to call it a day...
Man, I feel a bit bad.
But... I did it! I went out by myself and didn't even worry Shay!!!
[sound,sfxCageOpen]You climb to your bed, made of soft bedding.
Ahhhh! My bed! I [wave]love[/wave] my bed!!!!
I am getting better at making costumes!
Last year was... Well, goblin wasn't the best idea.
Everyone kept asking if I was Shrek!
Oh, I know you wanted me to be the giant cheese instead!
Ah- before I forget! Here is yours!!!
Honey! We are leaving in five!
We somehow ran out of Halloween candy...
I swear I didn't eat all of it! But I can't convince mom...
[sound,sfxDoorOpen]Protect the house from the spirits while I am gone, Spook!
Alright... This is my chance to go out for a little while!
Or... I can abandon those guys and stay with Shay, just like I wanted from the start!
They probably won't miss me anyway...
We are kinda short on drinks and candy...
[shake]BUT[/shake] I am working on the decorations!
So, yeah. Should be fun. Heh.
Wait, you don't wanna help or anything?
Uhh, I'll be on my way!
[wave]A L L  N I G H T  L O N G!!![/wave]
I decided I'd much rather stay in.
Plus we will see a horror film! I don't want to like, fall asleep!
You know, you can always just go back on your decision and stick around with us on the streets anyway. I won't judge.
No, right after this I am going home to wait for Shay!
We are throwing another one next year. You'll be a senior mouse 'til then!
I'd live a little when I was young, If I were you.
Came to offer some help with the party preparations, at last?
No, I was just looking around.
Don't be a stranger! We got plenty of heavy boxes to lift!
Uh, I'll be on my way!
Well, nope! I was busy [shake]HAVING FUN!!!![/shake]
Oh, mine's a surpirse! You'll see it soon enough!
We'll be down here. Party starts at sunset!
Return before midnight, or you will be turned into a pumpkin!!!!
Oh. wait. That's already done. Heh.
What's so bad about turning into a pumpkin? Pumpkins are awesome!
Come help with the decorations! Barry said he would, but then he went to sleep cause he is, uh, "Nocturnal".
You know what choosing when to sleep and wake up is called in my book?
I am the only one with taste here, anyway!
By the way, you better take off that mask. Might get in the way.
Hey, kiddo! Came to help out at last?
Almost thought I'll have to handle all of this on my own.
Alright, come with me! To the backrooms!
Screwdriver leads you to a room in the back of the bar. It's stuffy in here.
You see a box of Halloween decorations, some are really questionable objects, hardly even decorations.
Amongst all the items you spot a weird blobfish plushie, or is it an ornament?
We are going to create wonders with them!
It looks scary. I was scared when I saw it.
Of course! Who needs cheap plastic when we all have bones under our skins!
Um. I'd like mine to remain under my skin...
Well, you can have it that way.
Heh, just messin' with ya, kid.
Uh, wait. Is that a pocket watch?
You see a pocket watch. One side has a picture of Barry, the other - of the dog from the house across.
You've met? Wow, kid. You are quite the explorer!
Why does she have a picture with Barry...?
Oh little Spooky... You should've been there!
They used to be so grossly in love!
But... one is a dog... and the other is a Racoon...
You can't say things like that! They are two adult animals who happened to love each other!
There are more things to life than having cubs!
I get it, I get it.
Just caught me off guard, ok?
You said nothin' about the moth and the lamp!
I was scared of the lamp!
Wow! Super progressive, Spook. I am impressed.
Isn't that the dog that was sleeping in that house last night?
Well, someone here has good memory! Yeah, that's her!
Ah, just an old friend of ours.
Oh, no no. She is... another story.
Heh. Yeah. He had some crazy hair back then.
Anyway, enough reminiscing. Let's get things going!
You can start with the blobfish, I don't trust that thing.
I'll go make some ghosts out of sheets!
This thing looks important, but I don't wanna steal it...
[tw_sfx_vol,50]There better not be any [shake]STEALING[/shake] of anything that I stole in here!
[tw_sfx_vol,50]It means what I mean that it means!
I guess it won't be missed, even if I took it.
I'm kinda curious what people know about this...
It's none of my business anyway.
You picked up the pocket watch!
...Not sure how you carry it with you, as it is about your size, but, you manage!
You finish helping Screwdriver setup the Halloween decorations.
Well, would you look at that. Not bad, huh?
And we barely broke a sweat!
[wave]Haah[/wave], maybe you didn't, but I'm exhausted!
Don't worry, kid. We're already half way done!
Together, we'll finish this in no time!
Well, of course. You didn't think we'd forget about-
If you really didn't get tired at all, then you can finish this on your own!
Well would you look at that! Returned to finish what we started, at last?
N-no, I was just passing by.
Don't be shy, I know you want to carry that heavy box over there! [shake]C'moooooon!!![/shake]
You take notice that the front door is no longer guarded by the furry ball with ears!
You enter through the little pet's door.
How did you get past my bodyguard!?
That's [cycle,120,132]Great Dipper[/cycle] to you. The almighty protector of this kingdom and all who inhabit it!
Approach. What brings you to my palace?
Yes, peasant! You are in the presence of the Princess!
Bow and greet me before you speak of your business!
Bow and greet me before you speak of your business!
What is your name, humble peasant?
Spook, you don't happen to be one of the little pests stealing from my keep the other night?
I mean, your majesty, I wouldn't dare!
Hm... Very well. You should consider becoming my loyal knight, little mouse.
I can see you are cut for it!
I actually already have my Halloween costume picked out!
You bow your head and greet her awkwardly.
Well done, well done! Now state your business! I am late to attending my royal duties!
Oh, you know. Walk down the street, greet my people...
No! I am just saying that we've never met!
Am I to know each and every peasant in my kingdom? Do you think an actual Princess has any time for that?!
I don't know! I thought we had presidents now! [shake]This is very confusing!!![/shake]
Get out of my sight, peasant!
[alpha,0.75](I wonder if I should try and humor her next time...)[/alpha]
Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you!
You don't say "Your Majesty" to me! That is for the Queen.
You'll adress the Princess as Your Highness.
Goodness, these peasants grow more ignorant by the day!
Well, I am not from around here, really. Excuse my rudeness.
So if you're the Princess, then your human is the Queen?
Quite observant! Of course, my human is the most beautiful and powerful Queen of this land!
Are you going to be attending the party tonight?
My new friends will be there. It's Pogo, Screwdriver, Barry-
It's... time for my beauty nap.
It's... time for my beauty nap.
Hm? Well, of course you do! Everyone does!
After all, I've got great many pictures of myself.
I wasn't going to say anything, actually!
I can see you're hiding something! What is it?!
It was a bad idea to get involved! I'm out!
This is bad, I better get out of here!
Well don't dilly-dally! My time is precious, just like myself!
Actually, I got something to show you!
A gift for the royalty? How unexpected, how pleasant!
[shake]Remove that from my sight at once![/shake]
[shake]Where did you even get that from!? You are a dirty thief, are you not!!??[/shake]
No! I am friends with Barry!
[alpha,0.75](This is getting intense. I didn't sign up to deal with this!)[/alpha]
[alpha,0.75](Why did I even get involved? Now she's crying.)[/alpha]
[alpha,0.75][shake](Ugh...[/shake] I don't know if I should push her more right now.)[/alpha]
[alpha,0.75](But, there won't be a better time to get the answers!)[/alpha]
No! You should come to the party!
Oh, let me guess, because you are a princess and he is a pest!?
They tried to poison my Bar-bar! My owners thought he was going to attack me or my brother!
...It was so long ago. We used to sneak out at night.
My brother would play the drums.
Yeah, it was in the box.
But I believe Barry misses you!
Oh. Oh what a silly racoon....
Tell him I've moved on! I have a... mate... that I will meet soon! Yeah!
And tell Pogo I have a new best friend, too!
Lies! Your face says it all!!!
I am just an outsider. I don't know everything!
They do look very sad when talking about the old days. They definitely miss you!
I... can't go back. I'll make a fool of myself!
But you're such a class act! They'll be thrilled to see you, I just know it!
Tried to make a fool out of me! Now get out!!!
I think I saved those guys an awkward party! They should be thanking me, really.
You should come to the party!
Do you have more business here?
No, just checking in, is all!
I am a busy person, you know.
You decide to sleep until Shay is home.
You have horrors to witness at the comfort of your home!
I am never going outside again!!!! [shake]Ugh!!![/shake]
It's time to watch some [wave]zombie rats![/wave]
Few other animals are inside. There is low, darkwave music coming out of an old little speaker...
Didn't get the time! Was fixing up the place half of the time.
Well, Pogo thought the party was too boring. She went to read somewhere.
Can't blame her, dude. This is like a college dorm party.
Well. They usually suck, is all you gotta know.
Or, you know, you could always go back in time and try to help or somethin'.
Happy Halloween, kid. Try to enjoy!
You eat some candy and chat with a few drunken critters, and go home early...
At least Shay comes in not so long after!
I am never going outside again!!!! [shake]Ugh!!![/shake]
It's time to watch some [wave]zombie rats![/wave]
Oh. Sweetie. I am a Halloween decoration [wave]aaaallll[/wave] year long!
Bat suit. On your bat skin.
